name: Framelink MCP for Figma
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C7, C10; partly meets C6, C8; does not meet C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for figma-developer-mcp@0.13.2 names the repository `git+https://github.com/GLips/Figma-Context-MCP.git` and carries a provenance attestation (`dist.attestations`).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository (`SECURITY.md` in the repository), and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release 0.13.2 is dated 2026-06-18; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-06-24; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-10-27.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: 1 advisory is published in the repository's advisory list; it names a patched version at or below the latest release (0.13.2). Most recent: GHSA-gxw4-4fc5-9gr5 (high, published 2025-09-29, patched in 0.6.3).

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: The README describes the server as fetching Figma design data for the model; no write or execute tool is documented in the README. Quoted: “it simplifies and translates the response so only the most relevant layout and styling information is provided to the model.”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The README's configuration examples pass the Figma key as a command-line argument; an environment-variable alternative is mentioned. Quoted: “"args": ["-y", "figma-developer-mcp", "--figma-api-key=YOUR-KEY", "--stdio"]”; “Or you can set `FIGMA_API_KEY` and `PORT` in the `env` field.”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README contains no reference to telemetry or usage collection, and the documented function contacts only the service the user configures. Searched `README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`pnpm-lock.yaml`) is committed. No Dependabot or Renovate configuration file exists at the paths listed in the methodology.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: No statement about prompt injection or untrusted content was found in the files searched. Searched `README.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted, malicious, attacker, adversarial; `SECURITY.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.29.0. Lower-bound version 1.29.0 of @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (npm) was published on 2026-03-30, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.

advisories.summary: figma-developer-mcp vulnerable to command injection in get_figma_data tool
